title: Foreign Evidence
description: A reissuer's record that it verified a credential Bakobo did not produce, by that credential's own rules: its format and type, its issuer and certificate chain, the trust anchor, the checks that ran and those that could not, and when. Issued to the holder who presented it. Carries no claim value from the foreign credential.
$comment: this.i @vho4mibp. The check vocabulary is closed; adding a check is a schema revision.

t.description: Message type. Optional; an ACDC JSON message without it is of type acm.

i.description: AID of the reissuer that ran the checks

rd.description: SAID of the reissuer's registry whose TEL carries this credential's issuance and revocation

oneOf.description: SAID of the compact attributes block

i.description: AID of the holder who presented the foreign credential

dt.description: When this record was issued, as an ISO-8601 datetime

format.description: The foreign credential's format, as its typ header declared it

credentialType.description: The foreign credential's type, e.g. an SD-JWT VC vct

foreignIssuer.description: The foreign credential's iss claim, when it carries one

issuerChain.description: The certificates the foreign credential carried, leaf first

items.description: One certificate, named by subject and fingerprinted

subject.description: The certificate's subject as an RFC 4514 string

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the certificate's DER

trustAnchor.description: The anchor the chain was validated against

subject.description: The certificate's subject as an RFC 4514 string

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the certificate's DER

checks.description: The checks that ran, from a closed vocabulary (this.i @vho4mibp)

caveats.description: Checks that could not be performed, as Bakobo warning codes

verifiedAt.description: The moment the checks were made against, as an ISO-8601 datetime

oneOf.description: SAID of the compact rules block

evidenceNotEndorsement.const: The issuer records which checks it ran on a foreign credential and what they found at verifiedAt. It does not endorse the foreign issuer's claims, and a verifier MUST NOT read this credential as asserting any of them.

checksAsOfVerifiedAt.const: Every check describes the foreign credential as it stood at verifiedAt. A later revocation of the foreign credential or its certificates is not reflected here, and a verifier relying on current standing MUST check the foreign credential itself.

noClaimValues.const: This credential carries no claim value from the foreign credential. The issuer MUST NOT add personal data from it, and a holder presenting this credential discloses only that the listed checks ran.
